answer.evidence:
The handoff refs list A and D, which are outside the preferred pair. I took the preferred pair to be B and C and gave them 47 of the 60 minutes. I only grepped radon/metrics.py and did not read any file in full or open the handoff_refs files.

C (radon/metrics.py) holds the formula. mi_compute at line 98 takes volume, complexity, sloc and comments. Line 104 returns early when volume or sloc is <= 0. Lines 106-107 take math.log of sloc and volume. Lines 114-115 apply the -16.2 * log(sloc) term and the 50 * sin(comments_scale) term. mi_visit at line 136 computes the comment percentage as comments_lines / sloc * 100 and guards against sloc == 0. Review the bounding and normalisation, the comment-percentage scaling, and the zero guards.

B (radon/complexity.py) is the likely source of the branch score passed in as `complexity`.

A (radon/raw.py) supplies the sloc and comment counts. D (radon/visitors.py) feeds the Halstead inputs. Both get a short check only.
